artworks.title: D. Pineau, Sculpteur
artworks.artist: Jean-Michel Moreau after Pierre Paul Merelle
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: An engraved portrait of a man's upper body and head is depicted within an oval frame. The man is looking directly at the viewer with his head slightly turned to one side. He has a rounded face with pronounced cheeks and wears a confident expression. The man's hair is styled in a period-appropriate fashion, featuring short, curling locks framing his face in a powdered wig. He is dressed in a formal coat with a high collar and a decorative scarf or cravat around his neck. The oval frame is surrounded by an ornate border with floral patterns and intricate detailing. A rectangular plaque beneath the portrait is inscribed with "D. Pineau Sculpteur." The background has a textured appearance that enhances the three-dimensional effect of the frame and plaque, with additional filigree for design embellishment.

artworks.title: Jean George Wille
artworks.artist: Pierre-Charles Ingouf after Pierre Alexandre Wille
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraving of a man's upper body, specifically a profile view of his head, neck, and shoulders. The man is positioned to the right, showing a side profile with his face directed towards the right edge of the image. His facial features include a straight nose, defined jawline, and a slight smile, with his hair styled in an intricately curled fashion, pulled back and possibly tied with a ribbon. He is attired in what appears to be formal clothing, with a decorative collar. Surrounding him is an oval frame with decorative elements, set against a textured background. Below the portrait, there is an engraved plaque with text identifying the subject as Jean George Wille. The background of the image is textured.

artworks.title: Diderot
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The illustration shows a profile view of a man's head and shoulders. He is facing right, with distinct facial features including a nose, brow, and forehead. The man has short, slightly receding hair and is dressed formally. The image is enclosed in an ornate oval frame with floral motifs. The background has a textured design, and below the frame is the name "DIDEROT."

artworks.title: Glorification of the Host
artworks.medium: pen and iron gall ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Professor William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: This drawing shows an ornate urn adorned with cherubs and clouds. The central urn is decorated with scrollwork and flanked by playful cherubs in lively poses. Fluffy clouds surround the urn, creating a heavenly scene with beams of light radiating from the top. Stylized clouds spread across the background, giving the impression of an ethereal environment. The use of sepia tones and fluid lines adds a classical and elegant touch to the composition.

artworks.title: Male Nude Seated on Rocks
artworks.medium: black chalk, heightened with white chalk,  on brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Professor William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure in a dynamic seated position. His upper body is turned to the side with one arm raised upward. The man has strong and angular facial features with a sculpted nose and slightly open mouth. His hair is styled in short waves. He is nude, with a draped cloth partially covering his lower body. Part of one arm and leg extend slightly beyond the frame. The background features sketchy trees and foliage created with light and dark strokes.

artworks.title: Briare
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Professor William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from an elevated position overlooking a sprawling natural scene. In the distance, there are hills marking the horizon, a river meandering through the scene, and faintly visible clusters of buildings. Close by, there are dense clusters of trees and a path leading the eye towards the beyond. The brushstrokes are subtle and precise, capturing lush foliage with dappled light effects and suggesting the movement of leaves in a gentle breeze. The color palette is soft and natural, featuring earthy greens and browns in the vegetation, paired with light blues, grays, and whites in the sky and distant landscape, creating a serene and harmonious atmosphere.

artworks.title: Figures Seated Around a Fountain
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Professor William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures gathered around a stone structure. The drawing depicts a group of individuals engaging in leisure activity around the stone wall. The figures are shown in different poses, some sitting and others standing. The scene includes individuals wearing hats and flowing garments. In the background, light sketching indicates natural elements like trees. The composition is simple yet elegant, conveying a sense of calm and social interaction.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and wash, heightened with white gouache, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Professor William B. O'Neal
artworks.description:
The image shows three human figures inside a tent or draped structure. 
One woman is standing in profile, wearing a gown and a headband. 
An older man with facial hair is sitting, holding an infant wrapped in cloth. 
They are near a standing donkey, and above them is a cherub-like figure with curly hair appearing from behind a curtain. 
The background has sketchy lines and hatching, emphasizing the draped cloth above the scene.

artworks.title: Allegory of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and wash on blue laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Professor William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length figure of a person seated in a semi-reclined position. The person's face is shown in profile, looking upwards with facial features that are softly rendered, and they have curly hair. They wear a loose, flowing garment and extend one arm upward towards a branch of flowers above their head. The other hand rests on an intricately carved surface. The background features a simple arched shape with sketch-like details.

artworks.title: Persische Nachtigallen (Persian Nightingales)
artworks.medium: gouache, watercolor, and pen and black ink over graphite on laid paper, mounted on cardboard; the sheet bordered at the top with yellow paper strip mounted to support
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Catherine Gamble Curran and Family, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: Circles, stars, birds, and crescent shapes are painted against a tent-shaped structure in this pale-toned, abstracted watercolor and drawing. The tent shape has three peaks near the top and is stepped across the bottom. Where what might be called the roof flares over the straighter side walls are an R to the left and, to the right, an N with a curling, red swirl off the top right stem of the letter. Three gray birds with oversized blue eyes are painted in a field of other geometric shapes in shades of cobalt blue, muted purple, mint green, and faint yellow. A cluster of nested, curving pink lines in the lower left corner suggest a rose. The background is mostly white with three circles in shades of purple, and the paper is saturated with red and yellow that bleed into each other across the bottom edge. The artist signed the top left corner of the paper, “Klee.” The watercolor is mounted on cardboard. On that cardboard is written, “1917 92” to the lower left and “Persische Nachtigallen” to the lower right.

artworks.title: Blackboard
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jo Ann and Julian Ganz, Jr., in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: A young woman with pale skin stands with her back to us as she points to a blackboard with a long stick in this vertical watercolor painting. Her body is angled away to our right, and she turns her head so her face is in profile, also to our right. The blue eye we can see looks down under a furrowed brow, and her small lips are closed over a rounded chin. She holds the pointer in her right hand as her left arm tucks across her lower back so that hand hooks into the right elbow. Her honey-blond hair is tied with a light tan ribbon like a headband, and a braid is coiled at the back of her head. She wears a checkered white and pale-green pinafore over a long, sage-green dress. The toe of one black shoe peeks out from under the hem. The blackboard behind her is drawn with three rows of geometric shapes outlined in white chalk. Her pointer aims at a circle near the top right corner. The floor and upper half of the wall behind and above the board are pink-tinged tan, and nickel gray fills the lower half of the wall beneath the board. The artist signed and dated the lower right of the blackboard, “Homer '77.”

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saints Peter and Paul
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from three blocks in three tones of blue
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Andrew Robison, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring figures in a classical architectural setting. The figures are depicted in dynamic poses and flowing drapery, engaging in intense interactions. The background includes columns and steps, with additional figures in flight. The color palette consists of blues and tans, enhancing the depth and form of the composition.

artworks.title: Abraham Entertaining the Angels
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with wash over black chalk and graphite on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Alice Steiner, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a historical scene outside a structure with elaborate drapery and winged figures. The image shows a group of figures gathered around a rectangular table with a detailed cloth cover, near a house or building. The figures are intricately dressed in flowing garments, with some adorned with wings. The scene also includes architectural elements like a building with a visible window and door, set against a landscape with trees and a distant view of mountains. Dramatic clouds fill the sky, adding depth to the setting. The drawing uses fine lines and shading to give texture and dimension to the figures and the environment.

artworks.title: Polichinelle
artworks.medium: lithograph in black hand-colored with gouache and watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift (Partial and Promised) of Malcolm Wiener, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This print shows an old man in an elaborate outfit, standing with his body facing the right and his head turned to us with a neutral expression. He has pale skin, rosy cheeks, a white mustache, bushy white eyebrows, and white hair that hangs down on either side of his face. He wears a large light blue tricorn hat and a frilly white collar over a blue and white tunic with lacy details. A large section of his chest appears to protrude forward and hang down. He has white and blue trousers, one red stocking and one blue stocking, and red shoes. The man appears to have his hands behind his back, holding a long wooden rod or staff. The background is plain beige paper.

artworks.title: Harmonica Player
artworks.medium: lithograph in red and deep violet on blotting paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a series of lines and shapes creating an abstract composition that suggests human figures. The bold strokes in black and red give the impression of two faces, one positioned slightly above and to the right of the other. The lines have a textured and unfinished quality, resembling graffiti or a sketch. The positioning and orientation of the figures may suggest a conversation between two people.

artworks.title: Mountains (Berge)
artworks.medium: etching and tonal etching in black, touched with gray ink, on blotting paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Collection
artworks.description: The image displays intersecting lines and sweeping curves. The abstract composition is reminiscent of mountainous landscapes with jagged peaks and steep valleys. The overlapping layers and darker shading suggest depth, similar to shadows on rocky terrain. The visual elements convey movement and complexity, like a rugged mountain range.

artworks.title: Landscape with the Taming of a Horse
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink (iron gall) with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Harry Brooks, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a person taming a rearing horse with figures in the background. The drawing uses a limited color palette, focusing on brown tones. Details are sketched with fine lines and shading, emphasizing movement and texture. A tree is on the left side, with simple line work for the ground.

artworks.title: Mountain Landscape with Washerwomen and a Fisherman
artworks.medium: gouache over black chalk (laid on modern paper)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Morton Morris, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is high in the image, just below the sky, with distant rocky hilltops and small buildings among trees. The brushwork is detailed, showing textures of rocks, vegetation, and water. The color palette is earthy and subdued with browns, greens, and grays dominating, complemented by hints of blue and red in the clothing of figures and the sky. Closest to us are figures near buildings and a stream, with more buildings and rocks visible in the distance, creating a sense of depth.

artworks.title: Reclining Nude [recto]
artworks.medium: pastel and black crayon over charcoal, corrected with white gouache, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert and Mercedes Eichholz, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying face down with their head turned to the left. Their arms are bent at the elbows under their head, and their legs are extended. The person's eyes are closed with a calm expression on their face. They have short dark hair with earrings in each ear. The person appears to be unclothed, with a natural skin tone. They are resting on a white pillow with a dark blue blanket partially covering it. The background features a textured surface with soft shades of pink, beige, and yellow.

artworks.title: Study for Aita tamari vahine Judith te parari [verso]
artworks.medium: charcoal, black chalk, and pastel on paper worked over with brush and water
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert and Mercedes Eichholz, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art

artworks.title: Warrior in Renaissance Armor on a Rearing Horse
artworks.artist: Workshop of Peter Vischer the Younger
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horned rider on a rearing horse. The rider appears to be sitting atop the horse, which is depicted with its front legs raised and mane flowing. The drawing uses a monochromatic color palette of shades of gray and black. The rider seems to be holding something near the mouth with both hands and is portrayed with an armor-like garment that includes intricate line work. The horse is sketched with emphasis on its musculature and posture, suggesting strength and movement. The lines are decisive, creating a dynamic scene. The background is simple, allowing the central figures to stand out.

artworks.title: Figure Costumed as Hercules
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a side profile view, wearing intricate attire with a long robe, a helmet-like hat resembling a mythical animal's head, and holding a staff in their left hand. The individual's outfit includes ornate details such as gauntlets and scaled or feathered elements. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Miss Kitty Dressing
artworks.medium: mezzotint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals from the waist up, situated closely around a small table with various objects on it. Both individuals have their heads tilted slightly towards each other, suggesting engagement with the table's contents. One person has dark hair styled with a ribbon or headband, with soft facial features, and wears a dark dress with light-colored ruffled cuffs and collar. The other leans over the table, with slightly longer, wavy hair gathered at the top and a smiling expression. They wear a light-colored garment with visible ruffled trim. One holds a kitten with a small hat featuring feather embellishments, and other objects such as a doll in a similar outfit and a small jar or bottle are on the table. The setting is dimly lit, highlighting the figures, objects, and a darker interior wall space.

artworks.title: View on the River Wye, Looking towards Chepstow
artworks.medium: watercolor, gouache, and touches of oil paint (?) over graphite with scraping out, heightened with varnish and/or gum arabic, on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 30.7 x 64 cm (12 1/16 x 25 3/16 in.)
overall (mat size): 50.8 x 86.4 cm (20 x 34 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a river winding through a landscape with high cliffs and dense vegetation. The composition features a vast sky, with distant landforms visible on the horizon. Delicate brushstrokes depict foliage, river flow, cliffs, and trees. The color palette includes earthy tones and warm hues, transitioning from browns and ochres to light blues and grays.
